collectors.titleDetails: (4 total Queries, 4 of them unique across 1 Connection)

queries.sql: SELECT b.*, h.name AS hotel_name, h.city AS hotel_city, h.address AS hotel_address, h.type AS hotel_type, h.id AS hotel_id_ref, (SELECT image_url FROM hotel_images WHERE hotel_id = h.id AND is_primary = TRUE LIMIT 1) AS hotel_image, rt.name AS room_type_name, rt.bed_type AS bed_type, rt.image_url AS room_image FROM bookings b JOIN hotels h ON b.hotel_id = h.id LEFT JOIN room_types rt ON rt.id = b.room_type_id WHERE b.id = 1 AND b.user_id = 1 LIMIT 1
